endOfLine.meaning: Ends each line of a program

space.meaning: Separates two tokens where the layout wants it (§ 12.2: U+0020)

indent.meaning: Begins an element written on a line of its own: two spaces

comma.meaning: Separates the elements of a list: arguments, properties, elements of an array (§ 12.8)

openParenthesis.meaning: Opens arguments, a condition, a group (§ 12.8)

openBrace.meaning: Opens an object, the names of an import, an object type (§ 12.8)

equals.meaning: Gives a value: the initializer of a declaration, an assignment (§ 12.8)

colon.meaning: Separates a property's name from its value or its type (§ 12.8)

importKeyword.meaning: Opens an import declaration (§ 16.2.2), or, called, imports a module when the code runs (§ 13.3.10)

moduleUrl.meaning: The URL of the module itself (§ 13.3.12; the host gives import.meta its url)

fromKeyword.meaning: Introduces the module an import reads (§ 16.2.2)

undefined.meaning: The value of what is not there (§ 19.1.4), and its type

docComment.meaning: Opens a documentation comment: a multi-line comment whose first character is an asterisk (JSDoc)

bar.meaning: Separates the types of a union
